chapter: Baton Rouge, first New York trip, the road years
title: Baton Rouge years: Lee Fortier, Carl Fontana and Brew Moore
summary: He recalls Lee Fortier's bands, tennis with Carl Fontana and hiring Brew Moore.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So the trombonist you played with maybe was Carl Fontana?
In Baton Rouge. Lee Fortier, who you mentioned.
Anything else to say about those years in Baton Rouge?
I remember I played tennis with Carl Fontana...
What about Brew Moore? He used to...
I met him in New Orleans. I originally hired him... Brew Moore? Does it have anything about Brew Moore?
In this book. Yes, right here.
